audit_log.value: I run a small home organizing business and need a simple service agreement for a client. I help with closet cleanouts, pantry organization, garage sorting, donation drop-offs, and occasional follow-up visits. I want something clear that explains what services are included, what counts as extra work, payment timing, cancellation notice, access to the home, responsibility for valuables, photo permission for before-and-after results, and a simple way for both sides to review and sign.
12 months unless terminated earlier as agreed in writing.

duration: 12 months unless terminated earlier as agreed in writing.
effective_date: Upon full execution by all parties
